reason: The pet thing is honestly fun and I'd probably play with the free demo on my commute, but I'm not paying a monthly subscription just to invest when my broker app already charges me nothing. Signing up for a paid plan with no price on it isn't something I'd do.
objection: I don't want a monthly fee eating into returns on a few thousand bucks a month, and I'm not sure yet that I'd let an AI move my real money through a broker I don't even know the name of.
would_change_my_mind: A real-money tier that's free or just a few bucks a month, with the broker named, after I've kept a streak going in the demo for a few weeks and seen the agent not do anything dumb.
